nodes.label: Web Splash Screen Dark Mode
nodes.description: AshaSathi app splash screen dark-mode variant (available at 4x density). Displays the 'ASHA SATHI' wordmark in bold green text on a white/light background. A house icon with a green roof, white walls, and a green-framed window is integrated into the letter 'H' of 'ASHA', sitting above the 'SATHI' subtitle. The design uses a single green color (#4CAF50-range) for all elements with no dark background despite being labeled dark variant â€” the background remains white, suggesting the logo itself may be prepared for dark-mode host contexts.
